# Hi, I'm Luke

I am an ecologist interested in ornithology, animal movement, migration, and applied ecological research. I am currently a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the University of Exeter, where my work focuses on understanding how birds move through, respond to, and persist in changing environments. Outside of research, I am an active birder and regularly document my observations locally and further afield, with photographs and checklists available on my [eBird profile](https://ebird.org/profile/MTEyNDg3Ng/world).
